formulas.ascii: Q = sum over conditions c, from-classes a, to-classes b of (n_cab - e_cab)^2 / e_cab, e_cab = n_ca * n_ab / n_a, n_ab pooled over conditions. Terms with n_ab = 0 are skipped; a from-class without transitions is skipped. nu = sum over a of (regimes_a - 1)(nonZeroCells_a - 1). p = upper chi-square tail of Q (one-sided, greater); no multiple-testing correction.
